debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e f-o-r t-h-r-e-e b-i-d-d-e-r-s, l-e-f-t a c-i-r-c-u-l-a-t-e-d c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r f-i-l-e, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d v-e-r-i-f-y-i-n-g t-h-e l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-c-y o-f t-h-e b-i-d-d-i-n-g r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-e-n-t c-o-v-e-r b-i-d q-u-o-t-e-s t-o r-i-v-a-l f-i-r-m-s t-o c-r-e-a-t-e a f-a-c-a-d-e o-f c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t r-e-c-o-n-c-i-l-e-d e-m-a-i-l t-h-r-e-a-d-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t o-f i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e r-e-q-u-i-r-e-m-e-n-t.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r n-e-g-o-t-i-a-t-e-d h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n f-o-r n-o-n-w-i-n-n-i-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r-s, l-e-f-t o-f-f-b-o-o-k p-a-y-m-e-n-t l-e-d-g-e-r-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e f-o-r-m-a-l a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l c-h-a-i-n f-o-r e-x-t-r-a c-o-n-t-r-a-c-t u-p-d-a-t-e-s.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-h-a-r-e-d c-o-s-t e-s-t-i-m-a-t-e s p-r-i-o-r t-o s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n d-e-a-d-l-i-n-e-s, l-e-f-t a c-j-m-s t-i-m-e-s t-a-m-p-e-d s-p-r-e-a-d-s-h-e-e-t, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-i-n-g i-n-f-o-r-m-a-t-i-o-n b-a-r-r-i-e-r-s b-e-t-w-e-e-n c-o-n-t-e-n-d-i-n-g f-i-r-m-s.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r l-o-g-g-e-d b-i-d-s u-s-i-n-g c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d v-a-l-u-e-s t-o m-i-m-i-c c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-v-e p-r-i-c-i-n-g, l-e-f-t a-n a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l o-f d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-r-a-f-t-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t r-e-v-i-e-w o-f b-i-d d-i-s-p-a-r-i-t-y a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
